gaps.note: The page never describes the invocations (three stages, each fixing two coordinates of the index), the central wires per invocation, the order of the gates, or the gate labels. So the reader cannot check that exactly one edge per central wire decreases, that no other edge decreases, or that the loss is h (the paper's P tensor F, dimension h). Paper lines 1000-1010 and the residual table around 1024-1050 (Lemma motif-residuals) prove this.

gaps.note: Mis-typed: labels are subspaces of F=(Q^h)^{tensor 3}, while t_T and t_S^perp live in Q^h. In the paper the growth is P tensor <t_X> inside P tensor t_Y^perp, and the added dimension h-2 is that of P tensor <t_X,t_Y>^perp, with P a line. Containment of <t_T> in t_S^perp is what orthogonality gives, but the statement as written is not about labels. Paper lines 945-950 and 1048-1056.
